# Welcome to Playblast

Playblast is **self-hosted video proofing** for motion and CGI studios: versions, timestamped comments, frame annotations, side-by-side compare, and approvals — on infrastructure you control.

## What this is

- One free, open-source instance per studio (Docker or Synology NAS)
- Proofing-first: built for review cycles, not a hosted SaaS
- Install and operator docs on GitHub Pages: https://brzrk-motion.github.io/Playblast/deployment/install-linux-nas

## What this is not

- Not a managed/hosted service — you operate Docker, networking, HTTPS/VPN, backups, and SMTP
- Not a support SLA — use Discussions, Issues, and docs for community help
- Product marketing lives on https://brzrkmotion.com/playblast

## Where to go

| Need | Channel |
|------|---------|
| Install or upgrade help | [Deployment docs](https://brzrk-motion.github.io/Playblast/deployment/install-linux-nas) or **Q&A** |
| Defects | [Bug report issue](https://github.com/brzrk-motion/Playblast/issues/new?template=bug_report.md) |
| Security | [Private advisory](https://github.com/brzrk-motion/Playblast/security/advisories/new) |
| Feature ideas | **Ideas** category |
| Adoption stories | **Show and tell** |

We're in an honest **soft release candidate** phase — thanks for trying Playblast on your own metal and telling us what breaks.
